overall: The AG found the School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting notice of its joint December 29 meeting without the anticipated topics on the official Town website 48 hours ahead; nullification was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the School Committee failed to post notice of its December 29 joint meeting with the School Building Committee at least 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: Despite its efforts to post copies of the notice in other locations, the School Committee failed to post sufficient notice of this meeting because the notice posted to the official notice location—the Town website—did not include the anticipated discussion topics at least 48 hours before the meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's notice requirements
remedy_passage: We order the School Committee's immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
